justification: The EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030 aims to protect and restore natural ecosystems, which can positively impact the implementation of the Circular Economy Action Plan by providing a healthy environment for the recycling and reuse of materials.

The EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030 and the Nature Restoration Law are closely linked, as the restoration of natural ecosystems can help achieve biodiversity targets, and the biodiversity strategy can inform the restoration efforts.

The Circular Economy Action Plan can enable the EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030 by promoting sustainable consumption and production patterns, reducing waste, and increasing recycling, which can help protect and restore natural ecosystems.

The Circular Economy Action Plan can reinforce the REPowerEU Plan by promoting energy efficiency and reducing energy consumption, which can help achieve the renewable energy targets set out in the REPowerEU Plan.
The REPowerEU Plan may constrain the EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030, as the increased energy production from renewable sources may lead to land-use changes that can negatively impact biodiversity.

The REPowerEU Plan may counteract the Nature Restoration Law, as the large-scale deployment of renewable energy sources may lead to habitat destruction and fragmentation, negatively impacting ecosystem restoration efforts.

The Farm to Fork Strategy can enable the Circular Economy Action Plan by promoting sustainable agriculture practices, reducing food waste, and increasing organic farming, which can help achieve the circular economy targets.

The Farm to Fork Strategy and the EU Biodiversity Strategy for 2030 are closely linked, as sustainable agriculture practices can help protect and restore natural ecosystems, and the biodiversity strategy can inform agricultural practices.

The EU Soil Strategy for 2030 can reinforce the Nature Restoration Law by promoting soil health and reducing soil erosion, which can help achieve the ecosystem restoration targets set out in the Nature Restoration Law.
